title: Turnaround Targets and Vehicle Conveniences under the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
The network aims to return a vehicle held on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan within the turnaround target its plan sets, and each plan carries its own terms for a technician coming to the vehicle, for a courtesy vehicle while the work is done, and for collection and return of the vehicle. Amounts are in USD.

| Plan | Turnaround target (hours) | Technician may come to the vehicle | Surcharge for a mobile visit | Courtesy vehicle | Daily allowance toward a courtesy vehicle | Vehicle collected and returned | Collection radius (miles) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 48 | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 | No | 0 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 36 | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 | No | 0 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 24 | Yes | 45.00 | No | 0.00 | Yes | 15 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 12 | Yes | 25.00 | Yes | 45.00 | Yes | 25 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 18 | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | 55.00 | Yes | 40 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 24 | Yes | 35.00 | Yes | 65.00 | Yes | 20 |

### Notes on the standards

A surcharge, an allowance or a radius of 0 stands against a plan written without that convenience, and one plan carries a mobile visit at no surcharge at all: the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, whose surcharge is 0.00 although a technician may come to the vehicle.

The turnaround target is the tightest on the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan at 12 hours and the longest on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan at 48 hours; the Keyturn Care Complete Plan and the Keyturn Care Electric Plan share a target of 24 hours.

Collection and return runs to 40 miles on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, 25 on the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan, 20 on the Keyturn Care Electric Plan and 15 on the Keyturn Care Complete Plan, and is not carried on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan or the Keyturn Care Routine Plan.
